999008199.text:
なんか氷割っててガリガリいってるし
ガクンガクン上下に揺れてるけど、これ大丈夫なの？

localizations.en: The ice is making all these crunching sounds as we break through, and we're bouncing up and down... Are we sure this is safe?

999008199.text:
今んとこはな！　今までのフロッケ号と重心が違うから
操舵だけで精一杯だぜ……！

localizations.en: So far, yeah! The center of gravity's different from the old Flocke, so steering's taking everything I've got...!

999008199.text:
ひゃー、海が氷で真っ白だ！
空は暗いし、先のほうがぜんぜん見えない！

localizations.en: Whoa, the sea's completely white with ice! The sky's all dark, and I can't see anything ahead!

999008199.text:
ずっと太陽が見えないと、不安になりますね……！
本当に同じ世界なのかなって……

localizations.en: Not being able to see the sun for so long makes me anxious...! Makes you wonder if we're even in the same world anymore...

999008199.text: でもほら！　あの氷の上、見てみて！

localizations.en: But look! Check out the ice over there!

999008199.text:
あ、何かきらきらしたものが……
もしかしてマナですか！？

localizations.en: Oh, there's something sparkling... Could that be mana?!

999008199.text:
マナがあるってことは
ここはランターナと同じ地続きの世界って証拠だよ！

localizations.en: If there's mana here, that means this world's connected to Lantarna!

999008199.text:
もしかして、実はもう果ての大陸に
着いちゃってたりしない！？

localizations.en: Wait, could we have already reached World's End without realizing it?!

999008199.text:
海というより氷の大地だしさ、
マナだってあるんでしょ？

localizations.en: I mean, this is more like a frozen landmass than a sea, right? And there's mana here too!

999008199.text:
先ほどから星を見ていますが、まだいただいた海図に
あった座標にも到達していませんね

localizations.en: I've been watching the stars, and we haven't reached the coordinates on the chart yet.

999008199.text: そうだね。ここはまだ果ての大陸じゃあない

localizations.en: That's right. We're not at World's End yet.

999008199.text: おい、お客さんだ！　逃げられねぇ、やるしかねぇぞ！

localizations.en: Oi, we've got company! Can't run—we're gonna have to fight!

999008199.text:
おいでなすったね！
歯応えのありそうなヤツらだ！

localizations.en: Here they come! These ones look like they'll put up a good fight!

999008199.text: まったく！　進むだけで精一杯だってのに！

localizations.en: Seriously?! Just moving forward is hard enough as it is!

999008199.text: 援護しますから、思いっきりどうぞ

localizations.en: I'll provide covering fire, so give it everything you've got.

999008199.text:
うん！　背中は任せた！
いくわよ、相棒！

localizations.en: Got it! I'm counting on you to watch my back! Let's go, partner!

999008199.text: さあ、どっからでもこーい！
